comments.mergedPostDetails:
What is it: Add a feature where members have a shared group avatar list

Why: It allows for groups to have more value with a shared avatar for members

How:

Add a group avatars list to the avatar list featuring the group avatars

The amount of avatar shared can be increased in the future with group boosts or alternate discord like features in the future.
comments.value: This sounds awesome!! Especially for roleplay groups!

comments.mergedPostDetails:
The issue is that roleplaying groups with "Uniform"-avatars (like Police, Military, Clubs and so on) need to make their avatars public for the whole group to use them.

That comes with the problem that users that are not in the group can freely copy them.

So they use pricy commissioned avatars without permission for their own groups, try to damage the reputation of the original group or cause troubles, confusion and issues in general with them.

A simple upload-flag in unity like "upload for group [group.1234]" in unity would already solve this.

For this to work the creator needs to own the group or at least have admin rights.

It would solve so many issues for these groups with group related avatars.

I hope this is something that could be considered for the near future.

details:
It would be beneficial for the groups system to have some kind of access control to specific avatars (and worlds). 

Having group members have access to 'Group Avatars' (ideally from a group menu in game) for that group has potential for a few use cases:

- Share avatars with friends / clientele / supporters within app

Good for users who do not want to use custom avatars, but not necessarily technically inclined, etc. 

Also would be good for something like a Patreon tier reward.

- Roleplaying / themed groups

Allow access to avatars for that groups theme for RP / events. 

- co-working / testing 

Can test avatars co-operatively etc in-game, rather than pass files around. Good for multiple creators working on the same thing, or creator working with a client to make something

- Options for performance gated events

Events and clubs can provide appropriate avatars

Generally reduces friction for shared, semi-private content, and would make things more accessible in-app rather than externally!
title: Group Only Access Avatars
